name: transcript
title: Transcript
description: What a recording says, as cues that follow it as it plays.
use: Beside a player or a plain audio or video element, the words of the recording as a list of cues, each with the time it begins. The current cue is marked and kept in view, played cues turn quiet, and a cue plays from its time when it is chosen. Name the media with aria-controls; the cues are written in the page, or read by the behavior from the media's WebVTT track.

instead.when: The words are shown over the picture, a line at a time
Events in time that are not spoken words

keyboard.action: Enter the list at the time of the current cue, or of the first, and leave it again: the list is one tab stop
Move to the time of the next or the previous cue
Move to the time of the first or the last cue
Play from the focused cue's time, as the native button does

platform.feature: The TextTrack API and a WebVTT track
platform.fallback: Without the behavior a transcript read from a track is not written; write the cues in the page to keep them readable without script
The button back to the current cue appears at once, without the fade

classes.name: transcript
classes.description: The transcript, beside its media. Give it an aria-label and aria-controls with the id of the player or the media element it follows

classes.name: transcript-list
classes.description: The cues, on an ol, scrolling inside --transcript-height. Add scroll-area to fade its edges

classes.name: transcript-cue
classes.description: One cue, an li with data-start, the second it begins: its time, then its words. Quiet once played, strong on a raised sheet while current. A press anywhere on it plays from its time

classes.name: transcript-time
classes.description: When the cue begins, in small tabular figures, on a button that plays from there. The list's tab stop

classes.name: transcript-speaker
classes.description: Who speaks, over the words, when the recording has several voices

classes.name: transcript-return
classes.description: Back to the current cue: a small pill button at the list's lower edge, hidden until the reader scrolls the current cue out of view

states.name: current
states.description: The cue being spoken: strong ink on a raised sheet. Every cue before it is drawn as played

states.name: hidden
states.description: While the list follows the current cue; the behavior removes it when the reader scrolls away

properties.name: --transcript-height
properties.description: The tallest the list grows before it scrolls

example:
1. This is a short recording, made to show the player and its transcript.

  2. Each line of the transcript is a cue, with the time it begins.
